# moneybin synthetic

Generate and manage synthetic financial data for testing

Generated from the registered command tree, so every option below is one the command declares; `--help` on any command prints the same text. Shared flags, exit codes, and JSON envelopes: [CLI reference](../../guides/cli-reference.md).

Usage: `moneybin synthetic [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...`

**Commands**

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [`moneybin synthetic generate`](#moneybin-synthetic-generate) | Generate synthetic financial data for a persona into a profile. |
| [`moneybin synthetic reset`](#moneybin-synthetic-reset) | Wipe a generated profile and regenerate from scratch. |

## moneybin synthetic generate

Generate synthetic financial data for a persona into a profile.

Usage: `moneybin synthetic generate [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--persona` | text |  | Required. Persona to generate (basic, family, freelancer, international) |
| `--profile` | text |  | Target profile name (auto-derived from persona) |
| `--years` | int |  | Number of years of history |
| `--seed` | int (≥ 1, ≤ 9999) |  | Seed for deterministic output (random if omitted) |
| `--skip-transform` | flag |  | Skip running transforms after generation |

## moneybin synthetic reset

Wipe a generated profile and regenerate from scratch.

Usage: `moneybin synthetic reset [OPTIONS]`

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--persona` | text |  | Required. Persona to regenerate |
| `--profile` | text |  | Target profile to reset |
| `--years` | int |  | Years to regenerate |
| `--seed` | int (≥ 1, ≤ 9999) |  | Seed for regeneration |
| `--yes, -y` | flag |  | Skip confirmation prompt |
| `--skip-transform` | flag |  | Skip running transforms after regeneration |
